sources.snippet: If you're building this platform **at scale**, you'll need: - Manufacturer relationship management (to get current specs before product launches) - Automated spec tracking (cabinets change quarterly) - Licensed access to trade databases (KCMA, EPA TSCA Title VI) - Real installer feedback loops (not public forum inference)

bottom_line: Minnesota custom shop. All 3/4" plywood construction. Solid hardwood dovetail drawer boxes. Catalyzed conversion varnish finish. Blum hinges (165K cycles) and TANDEM slides (100K cycles, 130 lb). Single-source manufacturing. KCMA certified. Rutt/Plain & Fancy tier per Main Line Kitchen Design ratings (A quality).
